title: zehneria hookeriana
intro: Zehneria hookeriana, commonly known as Wild Tumour Plant, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region and parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Zehneria hookeriana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and fever, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which have been identified through various phytochemical studies.
